svg.text: The Drowned Gallery — Three Channels · Gate 1 measured plan
Derived live from buildDrownedGalleryLayout (the same call physics and the graybox read). Datums in metres; museum floor = 0, waterline = -1.5.
Top-down plan (north up = toward the grotto)
Developed long section — the dive: approach → descent → hub → channel B → air-bell B
Rock roof at -1.9 sits 0.4 m BELOW the waterline — no air until the bell. Bell ceiling 1.8 = 3.0 m over the dry deck (-1.2); eye surfaces at 0.4.
Developed long section — the rise: hub → drowned passage under the door → buoyant shaft → apron
The column rises 4.2 m from gallery depth through the apron's rimmed hole (reduced-gravity float = Gate 2 seam). Falling in from the apron lands in safe water (Q4 recommendation).
The ramp wades below the waterline · Walks down into the water · This room is entered by descending
Rock closes overhead; no air anywhere · Keeps descending the stair · Pressure — the water owns this space
One shaft of light overhead; three glowing mouths, the return, and a cool fifth opening · Picks ONE channel — any of the three · Which letter becomes your personal introduction to Water
A dark channel, that letter's firelight carried through the water · Dives the one they picked (drawn at B; A and C are the same beat) · One dive is the route; glow and length are character, not rank
Surface breaks on the stair; one performer at 3.0 m under a 3 m ceiling · Watches their letter alone, then dives back to the hub · Surfacing = meeting your letter, privately
The other two mouths, still glowing, still open · May dive them — or not; nothing gates the way onward · The room asked for one choice, not a checklist
The fifth opening glowing cool, not warm · Swims/walks the drowned passage north · This is the way onward, open after any single dive
A glowing water column rising 4.2 m · Jumps in and floats up (Gate 2 gravity seam) · Weightlessness — water carries you
The dome, mirror pool, waterfall, doubled firelight · Surfaces over the rim onto the apron · Reflection — the room shows everything twice
All three niches doubled in the black pool (finale restaging, Q2) · Walks the ring past the doubled frame · A, B, C together at last — including the two not dived
The carved gold-barred frame to Fire · Exits east · Water is complete after one dive; Fire is next
Sightline study (moving windows, aimed at the performer floor) · isolation · final frame
Bell A — run 7.3 m · 7 samples, 0 blocked · min floor margin 0.08 m · read 3.0 m
Bell B — run 10.3 m · 7 samples, 0 blocked · min floor margin 0.07 m · read 3.0 m
Bell C — run 13.3 m · 7 samples, 0 blocked · min floor margin 0.08 m · read 3.0 m
Bell↔bell isolation: all 6 cross-sightlines blocked by rock
Final frame (75° from the shaft rim): pool in, waterfall in, niches in/in/in
